value.rationale: The one-cycle graph family is the first natural complete cyclomatic stratum beyond forests; an exact all-q rank enumerator and all-arity degree census over all odd finite fields identify the structural exceptional support condition and quantify finite-field cancellation. This is not a routine substitution of a fixed tree or cycle graph, since branches may change whether all maximum matchings pair cycle vertices internally.
